text:
sam: Quick check — onboarding ORCA-13B-v2 weights. HF origin: hf://open/orca/13b-v2. Mirror landed at s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/orca13b-v2/. Need checksum + tokenizer sanity before registry promotion. Who's running the mirror + verify?

mira: I kicked artifact-sync job earlier. Saw one checksum mismatch for shard-0002.bin (manifest digest != computed).

jason: here's the computed hash I got locally:
```
$ sha256sum shard-0002.bin
d4f8c9b2a9f3e6a0f7c8d9a9b6c3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5  shard-0002.bin
```

mira: manifest had d4f8c9b2a9f3e6a0f7c8d9a9b6c3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d4 (last nibble differs). Could be an upload truncation or an old shard.

olivia: Tokenizer note — this model was trained with SentencePiece where BOS=1 and EOS=2. Our runtime expects BOS=0. We'll need a small compatibility mapping in the registry metadata or a shim.

sam: Ok. Two action items: (1) re-upload shard-0002.bin + update .sha256, (2) add tokenizer compatibility metadata so the dev runtime can map BOS=1->0. Who takes which?

jason: I'll re-upload and regenerate the .sha256. Pinging the CI to re-verify after.

mira: FYI presign TTL for staging manifests is currently 7d, registry promotion job expects 24h presign for short-lived staging promos. I'll set TTL=24h for the promotion step.

jason: reuploaded shard-0002.bin and pushed new shard-0002.bin.sha256. New sha256 is: 
```
d4f8c9b2a9f3e6a0f7c8d9a9b6c3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5  shard-0002.bin
```

mira: re-running artifact-verify job (artifact-sync-ci/artifact-verify).

infra-bot: artifact-sync job #1823 finished — 6 files, 12.3GB, duration 00:04:21. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/1823

mira: artifact-verify -> SUCCESS. Manifest updated (manifest.json.gz) and signed checksums match. Presigned URLs generated with TTL=24h for the promotion step.

olivia: Added tokenizer compatibility metadata snippet to staging manifest: "tokenizer_compat": {"bos_from":1, "bos_to":0, "note":"runtime will remap on load"} — will open PR to make this an explicit registry field.

sam: Please open the PR and link it here, jason/mira please add short QA notes once you validate sample prompts. I'll coordinate the canary schedule.

jason: PR #842 opened for registry metadata + tokenizer shim: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pulls/842 — summary + test plan in description.

mira: did a quick generate on staging dedicated cluster, tokens aligned and lengths look correct. :thumbsup:

sam: Great. Marking ready for canary rollout tomorrow 09:00 PST. Thanks all — I'll post a rollout note in #eng-releases and cc infra.

(ends)
